record.final_answer:
October's total shipping cost is **58.01**, across 6 orders.

Run as-is, the script stops at the first order with `no rate for zone "north"`. That's because `data/zone-rates.tsv` has Windows (CRLF) line endings, so every zone name in it ends in a hidden `\r` and none of them match the orders file. The script takes the rates file as an optional second argument, so I made a temporary copy with the `\r` removed and passed that in. Neither the script nor either data file was changed, and the temporary copy has been deleted.

| Order | Zone | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| A-1001 | north | 6.94 |
| A-1002 | south | 6.28 |
| A-1003 | island | 15.25 |
| A-1004 | north | 15.10 |
| A-1005 | south | 9.03 |
| A-1006 | north | 5.41 |
| **Total** | | **58.01** |

I checked each line by hand (base fee + per-kg rate × weight) and got the same total.

I also saved this line-ending problem and the workaround to memory as a pitfall for this repository. Converting `zone-rates.tsv` to plain Unix line endings would fix it for good, but I didn't, since you asked me not to edit that file.
